value.rationale: Gives a complete all-integer classification of the smallest monotone lacunary coefficient-step family at sharp limit two, showing why the p=1,2 restriction of a contemporary theorem cannot simply be removed. The obstruction is geometric and demonstrates a true close-to-convexity boundary, without claiming univalence failure.
